items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Then I worked -- not for, but with the legendary Punch Miller, with the All Stars on 43rd Street in Chicago.

ctx.x: Well, they had a club on 43rd Street called the All Stars. Musicans used to go in there and jam a lot. And I'd go in there and I'd run into Punch. That was like home base for Punch. He wouldn't go any further than from the All Stars to play, you know, and he had recently, I hear, there is a book written on his life, you know. And his contributions to music, you know, the things that he had done that I was unaware of. And I still haven't read the book.
